apple_sdk_replacement_proposal.conclusion: No currently published supported Node SDK upgrade removes unsupported jsrsasign. Retain Apple3.1.0 until independently validated migration; preserve patched direct11.1.5; a future validated lock must freeze transitive11.1.5 as well. Keep end-of-support lifecycle debt open.
apple_sdk_replacement_proposal.support_contract: Apple supports latest major and current README requires Node22+. This does not prove official Deno compatibility.
apple_sdk_replacement_proposal.why_direct_removal_not_sufficient: Published Apple verifier itself imports KJUR/X509/ASN1HEX for certificate OIDs and OCSP; removal of only our direct import leaves the dependency in the SDK.
apple_sdk_replacement_proposal.validation_scope: Synthetic signed-request SDK test covers bearer-token creation/transport override, not certificate-extension or OCSP parsing. Actual patched-version validation should include trusted chain and malformed/wrong-scope negatives; preserve Node/WebCrypto/KJUR compatibility fallback and fail-closed root/CA/date/scope checks.
